intro: About 3 million people live in Armenia, but millions more Armenians live around the world.

chapters.title: People
text: Almost everyone is Armenian and speaks Armenian, an Indo-European language with its own branch. Most belong to the Armenian Apostolic Church.

chapters.title: A global diaspora
text: Large Armenian communities live in Russia, the United States, France, Lebanon and Argentina. Famous people of Armenian descent include Charles Aznavour and Kim Kardashian.

keyTerms.meaning: Tracing its founding to Jesus's apostles.
